capabilities: Copy the converted HTML to the clipboard
Run the conversion via the 'Copy as HTML' command
extras: The README opens with a deprecation notice: the author is no longer actively maintaining the plugin and will not fix issues or release updates. Conversion uses the showdown library.
motivation: The author wanted an easy way to copy notes and share work with others while keeping the original formatting.
problem: Pasting Obsidian notes into platforms like Slack or Google Docs loses formatting because those apps expect HTML rather than Markdown.
summary: Converts selected Markdown to HTML with showdown and copies it to the clipboard for pasting into apps like Slack and Google Docs.
